Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
Do I need a clinical background?

Not always. Analyst and trainer roles vary. A clinical background helps for informatics and at-the-elbow support, and we tell you which roles expect it.

Are the roles remote?

Some are fully remote, some are on site for go-live periods and some are hybrid. Each posting says which.

Do I need a vendor certification?

Many analyst roles ask for a current certification in the relevant EHR module, or equivalent hands-on experience. The posting lists what the client needs.
